name: PT First Media Tbk
summary: PT First Media Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications and multimedia services in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Media Business and Content Creation Business. The company offers subscription television, broadband internet, and data communication services through digital telecommunications networks. It also engages in film and video recording, newspaper publishing, e-commerce services, and trading activities. The company was formerly known as PT Broadband Multimedia Tbk and changed its name to PT First Media Tbk in May 2007. PT First Media Tbk was founded in 1994 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
